title: Public Health Laboratory Systems Strengthening
description: When a national laboratory system fails, the cost isn't measured in equipment — it's measured in delayed diagnoses, unreliable data, and lost donor confidence. We build laboratory operations that hold up under real-world pressure, from the ground up.

title: Biorepository & Biobank Design and Management
description: Every sample in a biorepository represents a patient, a trial participant, or years of research that can never be recollected. We design biobank systems — cold-chain, tracking, international shipment — built so irreplaceable specimens never become a point of failure.

title: Disease Surveillance Systems
description: Outbreaks don't wait for paperwork. We strengthen the laboratory backbone of disease surveillance — for TB, HIV, and outbreak-prone diseases like Ebola — so case detection and reporting hold up when it matters most.

title: Laboratory Quality Systems & Accreditation Support
description: An ISO 15189 audit shouldn't feel like a threat. We install quality systems your team actually understands and owns, so accreditation becomes a byproduct of good daily practice — not a stressful annual scramble.

title: Biosafety & Biosecurity Risk Assessments
description: Biosafety failures don't make headlines until it's too late. We assess and strengthen the practical safeguards that protect your staff, your samples, and the surrounding community — grounded in frameworks including the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual.

title: Training & Capacity Building for Laboratory Teams
description: Consultants eventually leave. The systems and people they trained shouldn't need them to stay. We build training designed to make outside help unnecessary over time — real capacity, not just a certificate on the wall.

title: Laboratory Data Systems & Dashboard Design
description: A lab result is only as good as the data behind it. We close the gaps that quietly erode trust in laboratory data — the kind that don't surface until an audit, a funder review, or a patient outcome depends on it.

title: Technical Assistance to Ministries of Health, WHO-Aligned Partners, and Clinical Trial Sponsors
description: Ministries of health and global health partners don't need another report — they need someone who has actually run the lab, not just advised on it from a distance. That's the difference we bring to technical assistance engagements.
